notes.title: First Devlog Released! Big Updates Coming Soon!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!
I’m excited to announce that the first devlog for Dumbest Tourists of Timelines is now live! 🎉 In the video, I share my journey of creating the game and give you a glimpse of what it’s really like to be a time-traveling tour guide.
But that’s not all! I’m working on big updates to make the game even better, with new mechanics and features on the way!
In the meantime, you can check out the current version on Steam and add it to your wishlist to stay updated.
Thank you so much for your support, and I can’t wait to show you what’s next!
